checks.title: Add to cart produces exactly one correct cart line item

checks.title: Cart/checkout represent personalization via mockup image only, not as readable field=value text

Poll portal Orders list (GET /api/orders?by_teeinblue=1, TIB Status=Any, Store=Any, date range covering today) repeatedly over at least 90 minutes.

checks.observation_point: Presence and appearance latency of the new order in GET /api/orders?by_teeinblue=1 / portal Orders list UI.
checks.expected_result: NOT ESTABLISHED as a confirmed SLA. This is a KNOWN-FLAKY / known-issue area, not assumed fixed: one prior order (JTEL87JY0) never appeared across 90+ minutes / all statuses / both stores / 30-day range (OQ-order-001, still UNRESOLVED); a second order did appear same-session after an unverified user claim of a webhook-config fix (KB-011). Do NOT treat non-appearance as an automatically-new bug and do NOT treat appearance as proof the underlying issue is fixed — either outcome must be logged against OQ-order-001 for orchestrator/context-quality-reviewer follow-up.
